title: AI IDE Repair Execution Dry-Run Real Campaign Validation v0.1
objective: Validate repair execution dry-run consumption for real or near-real campaign repair decision packages, proving selected repairActionQueue tasks can produce execution reports and patch-plan inputs without automatic target repo writes.
acceptance: Use the existing near-real campaign fixture or equivalent non-private run artifact.
Generate a repair handoff package, then consume selected queued tasks with repair:execute dry-run.
Validate execution report JSON/Markdown readability, selected task boundaries, verification commands, and redaction.
Prove dry-run does not write target repository source files, create commits, create PRs, or mark acceptance passed.
Update operations docs, testing strategy, acceptance checklist, decision log, dev log, and progress snapshot.
result_summary: Near-real repair decision package dry-run validation proves repair:execute can consume selected repairActionQueue tasks and produce executionPlan, patchPreview, maintainerReview, verificationChecklist, redaction-safe reports, and noWriteProof without automatic target repo writes.
verification_evidence: tests/unit/repair-execute.test.ts covers near-real dry-run consumption from fixtures/campaigns/ai-ide-repair-decision-package/manifest.json.
repair-execution-report.json exposes executionPlan, patchPreview, maintainerReview, verificationChecklist, and noWriteProof.
The dry-run test preserves target source content and mtime while writing only report artifacts to the output directory.
